description: This file contains rendering functions for drawing snapping guides and lines on a canvas in a drawing application, including handling different snap line types, zoom levels, and themes.

methods.name: renderSnaps
methods.description: Main function to render all snap lines on the canvas based on the application state.

methods.name: drawPointsSnapLine
methods.description: Draws a snap line consisting of multiple points.

methods.name: drawPointerSnapLine
methods.description: Draws a pointer snap line with a cross and optional line.

methods.name: drawCross
methods.description: Draws a cross at a given point, size adjusted for zoom and mode.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a straight line between two points.

methods.name: drawGapLine
methods.description: Draws a gap in a line for horizontal or vertical directions, with visual indicators.
